name: Tortuga 1667
summary: Team social-deduction pirate game where British and French crews vie for treasure on two ships and Tortuga island.
rules_text: Each player gets a secret loyalty: British, French, or Dutch in odd player counts. Pawns are randomly placed in two ship lines determining Captain, First Mate, Cabin Boy, and a Governor on Tortuga. On your turn do one action: secretly look at 2 of 5 event cards, reveal one, force another player to reveal one of two, or move via rowboats to another location. Captains can call Attack votes, First Mates Mutiny votes, Cabin Boys move treasure between holds on their ship, Governor calls Brawl votes. Votes: participants plus one random vote card play a vote card face-down, shuffle, reveal. Attacks need a Cannon and uncancelled Torch to steal from galleon or other ship. Mutiny maroons captain if mutineers win. Brawl reallocates Tortuga treasures. When the Spanish Armada event is finally revealed, total treasures in ship holds plus team areas on Tortuga are counted. Team with most wins; Dutch wins ties in odd games.
